ARCS kitMolecule 63operator-pass

Operator Pass

Record each review pass on a piece of work as a row: the lens and its question, what it found, and the ruling (held, changed or broke).

States

Anatomy

#PartType roleToken (CSS variable)
1LensWho ran the pass (mono caps) and the question it askstext-secondary, text
2FoundWhat the pass found or ran, with any command in codetext
3RulingHeld (green: the work held under the test), Changed (cyan: an action was taken), Broke (red: the check failed), then what changedgreen, cyan, red

Usage

Use it when

  • A glass box: how a page or decision was reviewed, pass by pass.
  • Every pass ran for real; a pass that did not run is not listed.

Do not use it when

  • Do not list a pass as run when it was only planned; say Not run.
  • Do not colour Changed gold: gold means a limit. Colour has one meaning across the kit (arc weld spec 4.3): red a failed check, gold a limit, green proven, cyan an action or focus, plain (steel) unknown, magenta a paradox.

Data it reads

FieldTypeRequiredNote
passes[]{lens, question, found, ruling: held | changed | broke, note}yesfound may hold a command in backticks.

Access

  • Each pass reads in order lens, found, ruling; the ruling is a word, not only a colour.
  • Three columns from 38rem, one below.
